about: The Introit of the formulary “Most Holy Name of Jesus” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At the name of Jesus let every knee bow, of those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth, and let every tongue confess that the Lord Jesus Christ is in the glory of God the Father. O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is Your name in all the earth! Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. At the name of Jesus let every knee bow, of those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth, and let every tongue confess that the Lord Jesus Christ is in the glory of God the Father.
